R86-VERDICT-t_7c573d5f

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED

Independent audit of 0f6f399: the existing suite passes, but five isolated regression probes fail.

1. P1 — src/app/api/tts/route.ts:264-280: prune reads the listing, then lists/removes objects later. An older cleanup can read v1, pause, and delete v2 after the v2 writer has published the current audio. writtenPath is passed but never used; even using it alone cannot protect a newer version published after the read. Reproduced: v2 existed when its request returned, then v1 prune deleted it. Use coordination/fencing or defer deletion so a stale snapshot cannot delete the currently published version. Add the exact interleaving as a regression.

2. P1 — route.ts:23-25,224-232,359-373: the waiter gives up after five seconds and synthesizes without acquiring the live lock, while the winner can take eight seconds plus persistence. A 6.1s winner generated two provider calls. No-Storage waiters also immediately synthesize. Wait on the owner or return a retryable response; never synthesize without acquiring an ownership-safe lock, including the local fallback. Add slow-winner and no-Storage concurrent tests.

3. P1 — route.ts:92-105,125-134: expired lock takeover is a read followed by unconditional upsert; two claimants can both own it, and release blindly deletes another owner's replacement. Two simultaneous expired-marker takeovers generated two provider calls. Use an atomic lease/CAS with owner tokens and ownership-checked release/fencing; test expiry, takeover and late release.

4. P1 — route.ts:92-110,161-170: after an exists conflict, a returned { error } on marker download or takeover is treated as an active claim, so a storage read outage yields false 429s rather than local fallback. Reproduced status 429 instead of 200 when uploads conflict and marker reads return 503. Handle returned errors as well as thrown exceptions and test both. Also localClaims are not released when claim fell back locally with a non-null store (release checks store instead of claim ownership). Keep the shared/local scope and lease owner with the claim. Per-instance fallback is not a shared cross-instance abuse limit; define a safe outage policy.

5. P2 — route.ts:235-255,325-327: persist returns without pendingWrite when admin Storage construction fails. Once storage recovers, the memory hit never retries the shared write. Reproduced a successful first and second response but no shared object. Mark the path pending for null storage and test null-to-available recovery.

6. P2 — route.ts:61-63,149-166: budget markers contain raw client IPs and cleanup only targets the immediately previous window on a later miss by the same client; inactive clients and gaps leave markers indefinitely. Use privacy-preserving identifiers and a bounded TTL/independent cleanup, and derive client identity only from a trusted proxy. Test skipped windows and expiry.

Cache-Control no-store now includes 404 (independently passed). The locale and voice mappings are routed through shared helpers, and listing lookup precedes provider configuration; however the four attempt-2 fixes and seven original defects are not all resolved or regression tested. The committed cleanup test checks a different ordering and the simultaneous-miss test uses an immediate provider.

Evidence: npx --prefix /root/projects/movehome vitest run --reporter=dot => 36 files, 253 tests passed; npx --prefix /root/projects/movehome tsc --noEmit => exit 0. Independent head-pinned mocked probes: 5 failed as above, 1 passed (404 no-store). No real Google or Supabase writes performed.
